text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. There's something 
important I'd like to ask of you...
choice_data_list: Yeah, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's a shop I've been curious about
for 
a while, but I haven't had the courage to 
go alone...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... if, if it's all right with you, 
would you come with me...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I replied that I certainly didn't mind, 
and decided to follow Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where we ended up was a concept café with 
a heavy steampunk aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...The plates, forks, spoons, lighting, 
chairs, tables, floor, counter, walls...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of these, what 
wonderful craftsmanship...!! Ah... It 
feels just like I've tumbled right into a 
storybook!
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is a fun place!
Yeah, what a fun place!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...!! Over there are replica swords 
and shields...!!!? A claymore, a kukri, a 
shamshir--
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is such a fun place!
Yeah, what a fun place!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whaaaaaaat!?!? A 
col-collaboration!?!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"T-To think this shop is doing a 
collaboration with that 'Silver Gray 
Ghost'....!!!!"
choice_data_list: 'The Silver Gray Ghost'?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's my absolute favorite novel! An 
Umamusume hero shoulders a greatsword
like 
this, defeating evil wherever she goes, 
and then—!!
choice_data_list: "The Silvery Gray Ghost"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy can't stop talking. All I 
can gather is that this cafe seems to be 
doing a collaboration with her favorite 
novel.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to be able to visit during the collab 
period...!! What an unbelievable 
coincidence...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Hyo-o-o-o!? Th-Th-This is... the 
legendary "Grey Ghost's" sword!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wait, that voice... Digitan-san!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Wait, wha-wha-wha!? Rob Roy-san!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be, Digital-san,
you came to see 
this collab...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! That is absolutely correct!!
I am a 
huge, huge, HUGE fan of this series!! I 
came here fully prepared to enjoy this 
collab to the max!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Looks like you two share the same ...
Looks like you two share the same ...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Does that mean you like the 'Gray 
Ghost' too, Rob Roy-san...?!
choice_data_list: Looks like you two share the same ...
Looks like you two share the same ...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, I love it soooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The best part of this work is, without a 
doubt, the bond between heroes!! 
Especially the relationship with the 
Knight of Radiant Light—it's magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...!! Oh, I completely understand!! That 
unbalanced relationship where they 
sometimes help and sometimes clash... You 
just can't take your eyes off them, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rapid exchange of fast talk continued 
for a while. Seeing this, the store clerk 
cheerfully called out to them.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We're so glad to see you all enjoying 
yourselves~! Photography is completely 
free, so please enjoy yourselves to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! Then— What should we do? 
What should we take photos of first?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two look around excitedly in wonder. 
Since they're having such a good time, I 
want to capture this moment in a photo.
choice_data_list: You two, stand before the sword.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Both of you, stand in front of the...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be...! Will you take a photo of 
me?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave it to me!
Yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much...!! I'm sorry for 
the trouble, but I'll leave it to you, 
then!
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave it to me!
Yeah, I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a photo of Zenno Rob Roy and Agnes 
Digital posing with the greatsword
replica on their backs.
Both of them had wonderful 
smiles.
choice_data_list: I'm really glad you seem to be hav...
It's great that you have a friend ...
It's great that you have a friend ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a photo of Zenno Rob Roy and Agnes 
Digital posing with the greatsword
replica on their backs.
Both of them had wonderful 
smiles.
choice_data_list: I'm really glad you seem to be hav...
I'm glad you have a friend who sha...
I'm glad you have a friend who sha...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all because you came with me, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm really glad you seem to be hav...
I'm glad you have a friend who sha...
I'm glad you have a friend who sha...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, if it's alright, I'd love to share 
more of the work's charm with you, 
Trainer... Would you... be willing to 
listen?"
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Let's go check out that exhibit over 
there! Digital-san, please come with us!
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hah! Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is the Staff of the Sagacious Sage! 
When the protagonist hero clashed with
the 
Knight of Radiance, the sage used this 
staff to aid the hero—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is the Mysterious Fortune Teller's 
Orb! Whenever the protagonist lost their 
way, the fortune teller would appear out 
of nowhere and give advice with this item—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was talking so fast I only understood 
about half of it... so I thought it'd be 
nice to talk with her again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! F-Friend...?! No, no,
such a thing 
is far too gracious...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No...! It is merely my interpretation,
but 
as we shared our thoughts before the 
blade, I believe we are already comrades!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So please, let us continue sharing our 
thoughts on reading from now on...!! If 
that is all right with you, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeeh...!! Are you truly sure?!
Th-Thank 
you so very much!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If there is anything at all that I can 
do, please let me do it!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their discussion continued for a while 
after.
It seemed Zenno Rob Roy had found a 
wonderful reading companion.
